reviewItem.question: For "Make service-account name configurable in `flux create tenant` by @reiSh6phoo9o in https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/pull/5402", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

exposure.needed: whether the operator runs `flux create tenant` and wants a custom service-account name; operator CLI usage is not carried in manifests, values, or workload configuration

proposed.statement: Flux 2.7.0 makes the service-account name configurable in the `flux create tenant` CLI command (an added capability); the release note names no specific flag and states no change to existing behavior.
